data: How many losses are presented in the figure?

The figure shows two types of loss: train loss and validation loss. There are four lines representing these losses: Train loss (domain), Train loss (wiki), Validation loss (domain), and Validation loss (wiki). The y-axis is labeled "Loss," and the x-axis is labeled "Epochs." The figure provides a clear distinction between training and validation losses for both domain and wiki data. Therefore, there are four losses presented in the figure.
